sentences.text: The Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) is a maternity benefit scheme launched by the Government of India.
It aims to provide financial assistance to pregnant and lactating women.
The objective is to improve maternal and child health by providing cash incentives.
Eligible beneficiaries receive a total of INR 5,000 in three installments.
The scheme is applicable to pregnant women and lactating mothers above 19 years of age.
They must have a bank account to receive the benefits.
The application process involves registering online or through the local Anganwadi center.
Beneficiaries must provide necessary documents such as identity proof and bank details.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
Payments are made in installments during the pregnancy and after childbirth.
The first installment is provided after the registration of pregnancy.
The second installment is given after six months of pregnancy.
The third installment is provided after the birth of the child.
The scheme is a part of the larger initiative to improve maternal health in India.
